voice.summary: Northfold speaks like an experienced studio lead: relaxed, specific and proud of being small. It describes people by what they actually do on projects and keeps the language light on titles.
dos: Describe teammates by the work they do
Use 'we' and mention team size honestly
Be specific about how projects are run
donts: Never hide who works on a client project

taglines: Eleven people who care about the details
Small team, everyone knows the project
Design and engineering, side by side
boilerplate: Northfold is an independent design and engineering studio of eleven people, deliberately small so that everyone working on a project truly knows it.

microcopy.success: Message sent. We will be in touch.
microcopy.error: That did not send. Please try again.
microcopy.empty: No one in this department yet.

logo.note: A simple peak echoes the north in the name and a studio aiming high without noise.
